alerts.label: Payrolls surprise beyond 1 sigma
alerts.detail: Nonfarm Payrolls came in at 165.0 versus trailing 24m mean, a 1.1 sigma surprise. Bearish for rates
alerts.why: Payrolls drive both growth and Fed expectations at once, which is why it is the single largest source of rate volatility on the calendar.
